# ACS

```{r}
filepath <- paste0(getwd(), "/data/")
```

```{r}
# "HINS1","HINS2","HINS3","HINS4","HINS5","HINS6","HINS7",
cols <- c("STATE", "AGEP", "POVPIP", "PRIVCOV", "PUBCOV", "HICOV", "PWGTP")

acs_data_a <- read_csv(file.path(filepath, "/csv_pus_2023/psam_pusa.csv"), col_select = all_of(cols), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(STATE = as.character(STATE))
acs_data_b <- read_csv(file.path(filepath, "/csv_pus_2023/psam_pusb.csv"), col_select = all_of(cols), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(STATE = as.character(STATE))

acs <- bind_rows(acs_data_a, acs_data_b)
glimpse(acs)
```

```{r}
acs <- acs |>
  mutate(
    # recodes are 1/2; convert to 1/0
    insured  = ifelse(HICOV == 1, 1, 0),
    uninsured = ifelse(HICOV == 2, 1, 0),
    privcov = ifelse(PRIVCOV == 1, 1, 0),
    pubcov  = ifelse(PUBCOV == 1, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  filter(AGEP >= 18, AGEP <= 64, !is.na(POVPIP), !is.na(PWGTP), state_name != "Puerto Rico", state_name != "District of Columbia")

acs <- acs |>
  filter(!is.na(POVPIP))

nrow(acs[acs$privcov == 0 & acs$pubcov == 0, ])
nrow(acs[acs$insured == 0,]) / nrow(acs[acs$insured == 0 | acs$insured == 1,])
```

```{r}
acs <- acs |>
  mutate(
    expansion = ifelse(state_name %in% non_expansion, 0, 1),
    expansion_name = ifelse(state_name %in% non_expansion, "Non-Expansion", "Expansion"),
    low_income = ifelse(POVPIP <= 138, 1, 0),
  )
acs
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

map_summary <- acs |>
  group_by(STATE, state_name, expansion, expansion_name) |>
  summarise(
    uninsured_rate    = weighted.mean(uninsured,  w = PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE),
    insured_rate      = weighted.mean(insured,    w = PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE),
    privcov_rate      = weighted.mean(privcov,    w = PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE),
    pubcov_rate       = weighted.mean(pubcov,     w = PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE),
    uninsured_rate_li = weighted.mean(
                          uninsured[low_income == 1],
                          w = PWGTP[low_income == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    n_weighted        = sum(PWGTP),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(map_summary, "data/map_summary.rds")
```

```{r}
poverty_summary_national <- acs |>
  group_by(expansion, POVPIP) |>
  summarise(
    insured_rate = weighted.mean(insured, PWGTP),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expansion = factor(expansion, levels = c(1, 0),
                       labels = c("Expansion", "Non-Expansion"))
  )

# Per-state version
poverty_summary_state <- acs |>
  group_by(STATE, expansion, POVPIP) |>
  summarise(
    insured_rate = weighted.mean(insured, PWGTP),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expansion = factor(expansion, levels = c(1, 0),
                       labels = c("Expansion", "Non-Expansion"))
  )

saveRDS(poverty_summary_national, "data/poverty_summary_national.rds")
saveRDS(poverty_summary_state,    "data/poverty_summary_state.rds")
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinyjs)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(scales)
library(bslib)
library(plotly)

states_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2020) |>
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("PR", "VI", "GU", "MP", "AS")) |>
  st_transform(4326)

map_summary              <- readRDS("data/map_summary.rds")
poverty_summary_national <- readRDS("data/poverty_summary_national.rds")
poverty_summary_state    <- readRDS("data/poverty_summary_state.rds")

map_sf <- states_sf |>
  left_join(map_summary, by = c("STATEFP" = "STATE"))

exp_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#0342A1", "#C6010B"),
  levels  = c("Expansion", "Non-Expansion")
)

dark_bg   <- "#000000"
dark_text <- "#ffffff"

ui <- fluidPage(
  # theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "darkly"),
  # tags$style(HTML("
  #   body { background-color: #000000; }
  #   .well { background-color: #000000; border: none; }
  # ")),
  useShinyjs(),
  leafletOutput("state_map", height = "1500px"),
  br(),
  hidden(
    div(id = "state_detail",
      uiOutput("sidebar_title"),
      br(),
      fluidRow(
        column(3, uiOutput("box_uninsured")),
        column(3, uiOutput("box_uninsured_li")),
        column(3, uiOutput("box_pubcov")),
        column(3, uiOutput("box_privcov"))
      ),
      br(),
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotlyOutput("coverage_bar", height = "280px")),
        column(6, plotlyOutput("income_plot",  height = "280px"))
      ),
      br(),
      fluidRow(
        column(12, plotlyOutput("poverty_plot", height = "350px"))
      ),
      br(),
      actionButton("clear", "← Clear")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  selected_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  output$state_map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(map_sf) |>
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB) |>
      setView(lng = -96, lat = 37.8, zoom = 4) |>
      addPolygons(
        fillColor   = ~exp_pal(expansion_name),
        fillOpacity = 0.7,
        color       = ~ifelse(expansion_name == "Expansion", "#0342A1", "#C6010B"),
        weight      = 1.5,
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
          weight = 3, color = "#fff", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE
        ),
        label   = ~paste0(state_name, " — ", expansion_name,
                          " | Uninsured: ", percent(uninsured_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
        layerId = ~STATEFP
      ) |>
      addLegend("bottomright", pal = exp_pal, values = ~expansion_name,
                title = "Expansion Status")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$state_map_shape_click, {
    selected_state(input$state_map_shape_click$id)
    showElement("state_detail")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$clear, {
    selected_state(NULL)
    hideElement("state_detail")
  })
  
  output$sidebar_title <- renderUI({
    req(selected_state())
    row <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    h4(row$state_name, " — ", row$expansion_name)
  })
  
  output$box_uninsured <- renderUI({
    req(selected_state())
    row <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    value_box("Uninsured Rate", percent(row$uninsured_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
              theme = "danger", height = "100px")
  })
  
  output$box_uninsured_li <- renderUI({
    req(selected_state())
    row <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    value_box("Uninsured (Low Income)", percent(row$uninsured_rate_li, accuracy = 0.1),
              theme = "warning", height = "100px")
  })
  
  output$box_pubcov <- renderUI({
    req(selected_state())
    row <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    value_box("Public Coverage", percent(row$pubcov_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
              theme = "info", height = "100px")
  })
  
  output$box_privcov <- renderUI({
    req(selected_state())
    row <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    value_box("Private Coverage", percent(row$privcov_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
              theme = "primary", height = "100px")
  })
  
  output$coverage_bar <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_state())
    row <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    
    tibble(
      category = c("Insured", "Private", "Public", "Uninsured"),
      rate     = c(row$insured_rate, row$privcov_rate, row$pubcov_rate, row$uninsured_rate),
      color    = c("#2c7bb6", "#74add1", "#abd9e9", "#d7191c")
    ) |>
      plot_ly(
        x = ~rate, y = ~category, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        marker = list(color = ~color),
        text = ~percent(rate, accuracy = 0.1), textposition = "outside",
        hoverinfo = "none"
      ) |>
      layout(
        paper_bgcolor = dark_bg,
        plot_bgcolor  = dark_bg,
        font  = list(color = dark_text),
        title = list(text = "Coverage Breakdown", font = list(size = 13, color = dark_text)),
        xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1.15),
                     gridcolor = "#333", tickfont = list(color = dark_text)),
        yaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = "#333", tickfont = list(color = dark_text)),
        margin = list(l = 10, r = 40, t = 30, b = 10),
        showlegend = FALSE
      )
  })
  
  output$income_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_state())
    row <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    
    tibble(
      group = c("All Residents", "Low Income"),
      rate  = c(row$uninsured_rate, row$uninsured_rate_li),
      color = c("#74add1", "#d7191c")
    ) |>
      plot_ly(
        x = ~group, y = ~rate, type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = ~color),
        text = ~percent(rate, accuracy = 0.1), textposition = "outside",
        hoverinfo = "none"
      ) |>
      layout(
        paper_bgcolor = dark_bg,
        plot_bgcolor  = dark_bg,
        font  = list(color = dark_text),
        title = list(text = "Uninsured: All vs Low Income", font = list(size = 13, color = dark_text)),
        xaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = "#333", tickfont = list(color = dark_text)),
        yaxis = list(
          title = "Uninsured Rate",
          tickformat = ".0%",
          range = c(0, max(row$uninsured_rate_li, row$uninsured_rate) * 1.3),
          gridcolor = "#333",
          tickfont = list(color = dark_text)
        ),
        margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 30, b = 10),
        showlegend = FALSE
      )
  })
  
  output$poverty_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_state())
    
    row        <- map_summary |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    state_data <- poverty_summary_state |> filter(STATE == selected_state())
    
    exp_smooth <- poverty_summary_national |>
      filter(expansion == "Expansion") |>
      arrange(POVPIP)
    
    nonexp_smooth <- poverty_summary_national |>
      filter(expansion == "Non-Expansion") |>
      arrange(POVPIP)
    
    state_smooth <- state_data |> arrange(POVPIP)
    
    plot_ly() |>
      add_lines(
        data = exp_smooth,
        x = ~POVPIP, y = ~insured_rate,
        line = list(color = "rgba(44, 123, 182, 0.2)", width = 2),
        name = "Expansion States (National)",
        hoverinfo = "none"
      ) |>
      add_lines(
        data = nonexp_smooth,
        x = ~POVPIP, y = ~insured_rate,
        line = list(color = "rgba(215, 25, 28, 0.2)", width = 2),
        name = "Non-Expansion States (National)",
        hoverinfo = "none"
      ) |>
      add_lines(
        data = state_smooth,
        x = ~POVPIP, y = ~insured_rate,
        line = list(
          color = if (row$expansion == 1) "#2c7bb6" else "#d7191c",
          width = 3
        ),
        name = row$state_name,
        hovertemplate = "FPL: %{x}%<br>Insured Rate: %{y:.1%}<extra></extra>"
      ) |>
      add_segments(
        x = 138, xend = 138, y = 0, yend = 1,
        line = list(color = "#74b9e8", dash = "dash", width = 1),
        name = "Medicaid Cutoff (138% FPL)",
        hoverinfo = "none"
      ) |>
      add_segments(
        x = 100, xend = 100, y = 0, yend = 1,
        line = list(color = "#f46d6e", dash = "dash", width = 1),
        name = "Federal Poverty Line",
        hoverinfo = "none"
      ) |>
      layout(
        paper_bgcolor = dark_bg,
        plot_bgcolor  = dark_bg,
        font  = list(color = dark_text),
        title = list(
          text = paste0("Insurance Rate by Poverty Level — ", row$state_name),
          font = list(size = 13, color = dark_text)
        ),
        xaxis = list(
          title = "Percent of Federal Poverty Level (FPL)",
          range = c(0, 500),
          gridcolor = "#333",
          tickfont = list(color = dark_text)
        ),
        yaxis = list(
          title = "Insured Rate",
          tickformat = ".0%",
          range = c(0, 1),
          gridcolor = "#333",
          tickfont = list(color = dark_text)
        ),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2, font = list(color = dark_text)),
        margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 40, b = 10)
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
